data.content: ["Surfside Beach offers a relaxed coastal escape with excellent food options and outdoor activities, perfect for avoiding early mornings and enjoying leisurely meals without the club scene Alice wants to avoid.", "Matagorda provides a laid-back beach setting with strong outdoor activities and food experiences, allowing the group to enjoy scenic walks and good dining at a comfortable pace without nightlife pressure.", "Eureka Springs combines charming urban neighborhoods, shopping, and dining variety including Italian cuisine options, with museums and scenic walks that satisfy Carol's interests while maintaining the relaxed, late-start schedule everyone needs.", "Beatty offers a relaxed small-town vibe with outdoor exploration and balanced dining experiences, ideal for avoiding early mornings and club scenes while allowing scenic walks and a comfortable group pace.", "Clearwater Beach delivers a popular, iconic destination with excellent food and outdoor activities, plus urban neighborhoods to explore and Italian dining options, all while maintaining a relaxed atmosphere without the nightlife focus Alice wants to avoid."]
